verdict.rationale: Basecamp's card tables are pitched for work with "distinct stages," and its templates keep "the same structure, workflows, and setup" across projects. That suggests teams can model their own stage-based workflow. However, the evidence never explicitly says stages or statuses can be renamed or configured, and it says nothing about custom fields. missing for 10: custom field definitions, explicit documentation of configurable workflow statuses/columns, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Perfect for bug and issue tracking, software development, production work, or anything with distinct stages.
Create reusable project and to-do list templates with the same structure, workflows, and setup across projects.
